description: InfraTableContext ordinals 0-2: InfraPartitioned deploys the CtxPerString partitioned context, an unkeyed context-bound MyTable, an into-table sum feed and an s0 reading MyTable.thesum per SupportBean_S0 partition key, pinning c0=110 then c0=20; InfraNonOverlapping deploys the CtxNowTillS0 start-@now/end-SupportBean_S0 context, a keyed context-bound MyTable fed by a grouped into-table sum and an s0 emitting the partition table as one output-snapshot-when-terminated batch per SupportBean_S0(-1) terminator ({E1,110},{E2,20} then {E1,30},{E3,100}), with a late create index on col0 and a deploy-only MyTable/SupportBean_S1 join; InfraTableContextInvalid deploys the SimpleCtx scheduled context and a context-bound keyed MyTable, then pins three tryInvalidCompile prefixes for a contextless select, a contextless subquery and a contextless insert-into (Java source regression-lib/src/main/java/com/espertech/esper/regressionlib/suite/infra/tbl/InfraTableContext.java).

cases.observation: listener; the partitioned context keys MyTable per theString/p00 so S0(0,E1) reads the E1-partition sum 110 and S0(0,E2) reads 20

listener; s0 emits the whole partition table as one any-order new batch per SupportBean_S0(-1) terminator ({E1,110},{E2,20} then {E1,30},{E3,100}); the mid-run create index on col0 and the deploy-only MyTable/SupportBean_S1 join carry deployed markers only
compile-error; three tryInvalidCompile probes pin the context-visibility prefixes for a contextless select, a contextless subquery and a contextless insert-into against SimpleCtx-bound MyTable

steps.epl: @public create context CtxPerString partition by theString from SupportBean, p00 from SupportBean_S0
@public context CtxPerString create table MyTable(thesum sum(int))
context CtxPerString into table MyTable select sum(intPrimitive) as thesum from SupportBean
@name('s0') context CtxPerString select MyTable.thesum as c0 from SupportBean_S0
@public create context CtxNowTillS0 start @now end SupportBean_S0
@public context CtxNowTillS0 create table MyTable(pkey string primary key, thesum sum(int), col0 string)
context CtxNowTillS0 into table MyTable select sum(intPrimitive) as thesum from SupportBean group by theString
@name('s0') context CtxNowTillS0 select pkey as c0, thesum as c1 from MyTable output snapshot when terminated
context CtxNowTillS0 create index MyIdx on MyTable(col0)
context CtxNowTillS0 select * from MyTable, SupportBean_S1 where col0 = p11
@public create context SimpleCtx start after 1 sec end after 1 sec
@public context SimpleCtx create table MyTable(pkey string primary key, thesum sum(int), col0 string)
